reviewer: Codex static review (model-assisted; not an independent human review)

criteria.rationale: The trigger is limited to existing defects with unknown causes and excludes features, routine reviews, and final verification.
Inputs explicitly list expected/actual behavior, environment, affected roles/data, reproduction, source, logs, and tests.
Eight ordered steps require safe reproduction, causal tracing, falsifiable hypotheses, confidence classification, and a bounded implementation handoff.
The output contract separates symptom, reproduction, investigation, root cause, alternatives, proposal, and risk/handoff.
The skill is diagnosis-first and prohibits edits, data changes, destructive actions, and invented evidence without authorization.
Three direct cases cover ambiguity, diagnosis before implementation, and TDD handoff; formal coverage labels are absent.

gaps: Add formal coverage labels and an edge case for unsafe/unreproducible defects.
summary: Static document review only. This score does not establish behavioral performance; runtime remains NOT_RUN.
